description.en: Configures the renderer's antialiasing mode/level. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation, which validates the two arguments before forwarding them to the renderer's antialiasing setter.
Antialiasing mode (must be 0 or 1 for the level argument to take effect).

example.code:
// Enable antialiasing mode 0 at its highest level
CMND_SET_ANTIALIASE(0, 2);
